Senses.PreferredTarget: carry snow to fill a well
AlternateTargets: fill a well by carrying snow
Senses.Explanation: Literally, "carry snow to fill a well" (擔雪填井): the load melts while the well remains unfilled. Chan records use the concrete impossibility as a compact appraisal of ineffective religious display and effort. Baishan applies it separately to "pick it up and immediately use it" (拈來便用), to question-and-answer exchanges in an enumeration beside "talking mysteries, drawing a cake to satisfy hunger" (談玄說妙，畫餅充饑), and to trying to pass through by silent stillness, contrasted with trying to state it in words as "proving a turtle to be a soft-shelled turtle" (證龜成鱉). Tian'an calls sitting Chan like carrying snow to fill a well and rhymingly calls composing poetry kneading snow into a ball (捏雪成團). Yinyuan pairs the phrase with trying to fill a net by blowing (吹網欲滿) and says that even ages of such actions have no place. The Zen-specific deployment is a verdict applied not to an ordinary futile chore but to recognizable Chan-scene responses—silence, words, questions and answers, sitting, gestures, and other attempted displays.
Senses.Note: The exact phrase has 32 hits in 28 allowlisted texts. No formula self-definition was found; its predicates emerge from enumerations and explicit similes. Three distinct Baishan deployments are retained because they assign the image to different response shapes; independent Tian'an and Yinyuan passages establish broader use.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若道拈來便用，何異擔雪填井。若道總不與麼，也是證龜成鱉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 山西柏山楷禪師語錄. Baishan Dekai is the exact actor: he says 若道拈來便用，何異擔雪填井.

Occurrences.Kwic: 拈椎豎拂，望梅止渴，談玄說玅，畫餅充饑，一問一荅，擔雪填井，行棒行喝，無事生事。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 山西柏山楷禪師語錄. Baishan Dekai is the exact actor: his enumeration pairs 一問一答 with 擔雪填井.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若以寂默通，則擔雪填井；若以語言道，則證龜成鱉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 山西柏山楷禪師語錄. Baishan Dekai is the exact actor: his 普說 uses 擔雪填井 in the silent-stillness contrast.

Occurrences.Kwic: 坐禪者，大似擔雪填井。吟詩者，何異捏雪成團？惟有說食者卻最親切。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 天岸昇禪師語錄, winter informal address. Tian'an Sheng is the exact speaker of the stored comparison: sitting dhyana resembles carrying snow to fill a well, composing verse resembles pinching snow into a ball, while speaking of food is closest.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所作所為，擔雪填井，吹綱欲滿，縱經塵劫，無有是處。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 隱元禪師語錄, hall address. Yinyuan Longqi is the exact speaker: he says action performed with the slightest attachment is carrying snow to fill a well and blowing a net in hopes of filling it, futile even across dust-eons.
